entities.name: Aetherspark
entities.description: Artifact containing an artificial planeswalker's spark created by Ishikari Bindra; prize of the second Ghirapur Grand Prix.

entities.name: Ishikari Bindra
entities.description: Inventor from Avishkar who created the Aetherspark and died activating it.

entities.name: Consulate
entities.description: Faction Bindra defied, which held the Aetherspark in storage.

entities.name: Realmbreaker
entities.description: Used by Phyrexians to breach the Blind Eternities.

entities.name: Avishkar Assembly
entities.description: Agents recovered the Aetherspark and offered it as a prize.

entities.name: Ghirapur Grand Prix
entities.description: Interplanar race whose second running awarded the Aetherspark.

entities.name: Champions of Amonkhet
entities.description: Winners of the 2nd Ghirapur Grand Prix who claimed the Aetherspark.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: Competed in the Grand Prix to win the prize for Nissa.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: Planeswalker for whom Chandra sought the prize.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion during which the Blind Eternities were breached.

entities.name: Blind Eternities
entities.description: Space between planes breached by the Phyrexians.

events.summary: Ishikari Bindra activates her machine as the Phyrexians breach the Blind Eternities, creating the Aetherspark, and dies in the process.
events.quote: she died in the process of activating it

events.summary: Agents of the Avishkar Assembly recover the Aetherspark from Consulate storage.
events.quote: The Aetherspark was recovered from Consulate storage by agents of the Avishkar Assembly

events.summary: Chandra Nalaar competes in the Ghirapur Grand Prix to win the prize for Nissa Revane.
events.quote: Chandra Nalaar competes in the Ghirapur Grand Prix to win the prize for Nissa Revane .

events.summary: The Champions of Amonkhet win the 2nd Ghirapur Grand Prix and claim the Aetherspark.
events.quote: The Champions of Amonkhet claimed the Aetherspark as the winners of the 2nd Ghirapur Grand Prix .
